clips.title: The story
paras: At Anvilmar, Thran Khorman trains new warriors for the dangers of Coldridge Valley.

Thran Khorman drills dwarven recruits and visiting gnomes on the grounds of Anvilmar. Gruff and demanding, he has little patience for anyone who lacks the grit for front-line fighting. Though the Third War has ended, troggs press into Coldridge Pass, and danger still fills the mountains. Thran insists on relentless practice with axe, mace, and shield so Ironforge’s defenders stay ready.
